blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists should plan and budget their fuel purchases, as fuel products will experience mixed price adjustments next week. Diesel products will see another round of price hikes next week due to escalating geopolitical conflict. READ: Attack on Saudi’s Dammam airport leaves 1 dead, 8 injured In an advisory on Friday, Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas said the prices of diesel may increase by P2 to P2.50 per liter. Meanwhile, motorists may also get a small relief, with gasoline slated for a rollback of P1 to P1.50 per liter. READ: Saudi Arabia reports Filipino killed in drone attack on oil […]...
